annotations.title: COVID, flu and RSV levels by state

description: CDC wastewater viral activity levels for COVID-19, flu (influenza A) and RSV in one US state, DC or territory for the latest week: how many sewershed sites are Very Low, Low, Moderate, High or Very High, the share of people served by High or Very High sites, the median site level and the change from the week before, a 6-week trend, and the state's emergency department acute respiratory illness level.

pathogen.description: covid (SARS-CoV-2), flu (influenza A), rsv, or all. Default all.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, e.g. "Ohio" or "OH". DC, Puerto Rico and territories also work.

title: COVID, flu and RSV levels in a state
